title: New DependencyType enum label must land with its rest_store wiring or proto conversion fails
answers: registering a model to Unity Catalog fails with unknown enum label
new UC resource type dependency rejected when logging a model version
how do I add a new model dependency type for Unity Catalog registration
DATABRICKS_UC_MODEL_SERVICE dependency not recorded on model version
body:
Symptom: Registering a model version to Unity Catalog fails during proto conversion with an "unknown enum label" error once a new resource type is emitted as a dependency.
Root cause: mlflow/store/_unity_catalog/registry/rest_store.py:get_model_version_dependencies emits dependency type strings (_DEP_TYPE_* constants) that must match a member of the DependencyType enum in mlflow/protos/databricks_uc_registry_messages.proto.
Fix pattern: Append the new member with the next free number (e.g. DATABRICKS_UC_MODEL_SERVICE = 6) to the proto enum, regenerate the _pb2 and _pb2.pyi outputs, and add the matching _DEP_TYPE_* constant and emitting branch in the same change. Never emit the string before the enum exists.
Constraints: Applies to Unity Catalog model-version dependencies only. Enum numbers are append-only; do not renumber existing members.
applies: Unity Catalog model-version dependency types (DependencyType enum and rest_store wiring).
says: Registering a model version to the catalog fails with an unknown label error.
Saving a new model version is rejected when linking an unsupported resource dependency.
Support recording newly introduced cloud service dependencies when publishing catalog models.
Model version registration in the catalog drops or rejects connected service resources.
search: Adding a Unity Catalog model-version dependency type requires defining the member in the DependencyType enum in mlflow/protos/databricks_uc_registry_messages.proto and emitting its string constant in mlflow/store/_unity_catalog/registry/rest_store.py:get_model_version_dependencies. The new enum member must be appended with the next free number, stubs regenerated, and the matching _DEP_TYPE_* constant and emitting branch added in the exact same change to prevent proto conversion errors. A dependency type string must never be emitted before its corresponding enum member exists. This guidance applies strictly to Unity Catalog model-version dependencies, and existing enum numbers must not be renumbered.
